Renamed the ADR-037 fragment's schema slug PeriodClose → FiscalPeriod (canonical fleet name; AR / AP / VAT / WIP / ICP / R&D-subsidies sibling schemas already declared relatedSchema: FiscalPeriod). Added the missing 'name' field per REQ-PC-002 + included it in the schema's required set. Updated 5 PHP slug references (PeriodCloseService 3 sites, PeriodCloseGuard 2 sites) + the manifest fragment's config.schema (2 sites) + the fragment test's slug + name expectations (PeriodCloseFragmentTest 5 tests / 65 assertions PASS).

FiscalPeriod lifecycle declares field: state, initialState: open, the four labelled states (open / closing / closed / audit-locked), and four transitions: startClose (open→closing, roles: [period-closer]), close (closing→closed, roles: [period-closer], preconditions: PeriodCloseGuard::mandatoryChecklistResolved, action: set-fields closedAt/closedBy), reopen (closed→open, roles: [period-closer], preconditions: PeriodCloseGuard::closeReasonSupplied, action: append-reopen-history), lockForAudit (closed→audit-locked, roles: [auditor], action: set-fields auditLockedAt/auditLockedBy). The audit-locked state declares no outgoing transition → irreversibility at the schema level.

New ADR-037 augmentation on GLLine: periodRelation { localField: periodId, relatedSchema: FiscalPeriod, relatedField: periodId, cardinality: many-to-one }. Additive merge — the monolith's existing parentTransaction / account / costCenterRelation / kostenDragerRelation / projectRelation blocks survive the union (ADR-037 fragment semantics). Existing stub-string periodId values resolve by exact match — no destructive data migration. Repair-step backfill (Task 11) creates FiscalPeriod records for every distinct historical (administrationId, periodId) tuple so the FK resolves cleanly.

The ADR-037 fragment additively augments GLTransaction.post with the closed-period rejection precondition (PHP-form: OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\PeriodCloseGuard::periodOpen). The guard resolves the posting's periodId (or postingDate fallback) to a FiscalPeriod record scoped to the transaction's administration and rejects when state ∈ {closed, audit-locked}. Backwards-compatible during T2 rollout — a periodId that does not resolve is treated as open. PeriodCloseFragmentTest::testAugmentsGlTransactionPostAdditively asserts that the pre-existing BalanceGuard::isBalanced requires + allocation action survive the merge.

Reopen workflow lands as the declarative reopen transition (closed → open, roles: [period-closer], precondition: PeriodCloseGuard::closeReasonSupplied) + PeriodCloseService::reopenPeriod() server-side body guard (requireRole('period-closer'), non-empty closeReason validation, append history entry, clear closedAt/closedBy, save via OR ObjectService, audit-trail entry). The audit-locked state declares no outgoing transition → reopen of audit-locked rejected at the schema level per REQ-PC-006. PeriodCloseServiceTest covers reopen-without-reason FAILS, reopen-without-role FAILS, and successful reopen appends history + clears stamps — all PASS.

ADR-037 modular manifest fragment merged at runtime in src/main.js via require.context('./manifest.d/'). Menu: Bookkeeping > Period Close (icon CalendarLock, order 65). Pages: index page /bookkeeping/period-close binding to register: shillinq / schema: FiscalPeriod with columns periodId/name/administrationId/fiscalYear/startDate/endDate/state/closedAt (added the name column); detail page /bookkeeping/period-close/:id surfacing every REQ-PC-002 field + lifecycle action buttons (startClose/close/reopen/lockAudit with role gates + closeReason prompt on reopen) + a NEW links block carrying trial-balance-preview at /bookkeeping/trial-balance?periodId=:periodId visible in states open/closing/closed per REQ-PC-007. node tests/validate-manifest.js PASS (190 pages, structural + consistency 0 issues).

New repair step wired into appinfo/info.xml <post-migration> after InitializeSettings. Lists every GLLine carrying a non-empty periodId via OR ObjectService::findAll, buckets distinct (administrationId, periodId) tuples, filters FiscalPeriod for an existing match (skip → idempotent), and otherwise saves a minimal state: open record with derived name/startDate/endDate/fiscalYear parsed from the periodId slug (YYYY-Qn quarter, YYYY-Mnn / YYYY-nn month, YYYY-Wnn ISO week, FYYYYY fiscal year, year-only fallback). Best-effort error handling — failures log a warning + emit IOutput::warning so the app upgrade is never blocked. 6 tests / 23 assertions PASS in container PHPUnit run: name human-readable, empty-table no-op, distinct-tuple creation, idempotency on repeated runs, derived-field correctness across all five periodId shapes, open-state empty-history invariant.

Added a full ### FiscalPeriod entity entry between FiscalYear and FixedAsset: 14-column property table (per REQ-PC-002), relations to Administration / GLLine / GLTransaction / sibling-FK consumers, four-state x-openregister-lifecycle with role gates + preconditions + declarative actions, additive GLTransaction.post precondition (PeriodCloseGuard::periodOpen), idempotent BackfillFiscalPeriods repair-step. Reconciliation note explaining how the entry supersedes the inline FiscalPeriod callout under FiscalYear (kept additive — the enactedTaxRates deferred-tax extension remains compatible) and documenting the historical PeriodClose → FiscalPeriod schema-slug rename.
